## Content Analysis / 内容分析
**EN:** The following code configures vLLM to use speculative decoding where proposals are generated by draft models that condition draft predictions on both context vectors and sampled tokens. For more information see The Hitchhiker's Guide to Speculative Decoding an. Major sections include `MLP Drafter Example`, `Pre-Trained MLP Drafter Models`.
